<h2 style="text-align: center; text-indent: 0cm; mso-list: none; margin: 0cm 0cm 18.9pt .3pt;" align="center" class="akch-demoted-h1"><b style="font-size: 16px;">Learning Objectives: </b><span style="font-size: 16px;">The goal of this project is to harden password-based authentication by incorporating information obtained from a second factor (two-factor authentication, or 2FA). We will use the Linux login command to explore this. Although somewhat contrived, the motivation for the 2FA scheme in this project is similar to the password hardening paper discussed in the lectures. More specifically, information maintained by the system to validate a login request is updated after each successful login to limit the effectiveness of offline guessing attacks. The learning objectives of this project are listed below.</span></h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->1.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Understand how password-based authentication is implemented.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->2.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Understand the benefits of using multiple factors for stronger authentication.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->3.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Augment a password-based login command to include an additional factor from a second source.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l1 level1 lfo1; margin: 0cm 0cm 5.35pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->4.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Analyze the security benefits (or lack thereof) of the 2FA implementation.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 13.5pt -.25pt;">To keep it simple, this project focuses only on hardening the basic login scheme for a desktop or laptop system. The scheme can be extended to support password hardening for remote logins as well.

<h2 style="margin-left: -.25pt;">Project Setup</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 0cm; line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.85pt 0cm;"><b><i>Note: The link to the VM will be posted on an Ed Discussion pinned post.</i></b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm .5pt -.25pt;">For this project, you will be provided with an Ubuntu-based Virtual Machine (VM). This

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 6.3pt;">VM was tested on Oracle VM VirtualBox 7.0 and can be directly imported into it<a title="" href="file:///C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/CQFProject/FALL2026/CS6238/Project2/Project2.pdf#_ftn1" name="_ftnref1"><sup><!-- [if !supportFootnotes]--><sup><span style="font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial; color: black; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">[1]</span></sup><!--[endif]--></sup></a>. The VM has a default account “cs6238” with normal user privileges. To access a file as root, open a terminal, type <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">sudo su</span>, enter the “cs6238” password, and then access the file.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 1.9pt;">The password for the “cs6238” account is “cs6238”. Do not include the quotation marks when entering the password. Once logged in, run the following commands:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 36.05pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l11 level1 lfo2; margin: 0cm 141.9pt 0cm 18.0pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">1.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">cd /home/cs6238/Desktop</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 36.05pt; line-height: 145%; mso-list: l11 level1 lfo2; margin: 0cm 141.9pt 0cm 18.0pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; line-height: 145%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">2.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 145%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">git clone https://github.com/TA-gatech/Project2.git</span> This project folder contains:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: 104%; mso-list: l12 level1 lfo3; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.25pt 35.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->2 Python code files: <i>check_login.py</i> and <i>create_user.py</i>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l12 level1 lfo3; margin: 0cm 0cm 2.45pt 35.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->2 application password files modeled after <span style="font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">/etc/shadow</span> and <span style="font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">/etc/passwd</span>:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 0cm; line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.05pt 36.05pt;"><span style="font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">./app/<i>shadow</i></span> and <span style="font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">./app<i>/passwd</i></span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: 104%; mso-list: l12 level1 lfo3; margin: 0cm 0cm 13.45pt 35.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->1 executable: <i>token_generator</i>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 12.15pt -.25pt;">Additional details on these files and the executable are provided later.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.7pt -.25pt;"><b>IMPORTANT NOTE: </b>Make sure to work with the <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">./app/passwd</span> and <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">./app/shadow</span> files provided while working on this project. These are full paths to the files necessary for testing when submitting to Gradescope.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.5pt -.25pt;">Before starting the project, familiarize yourself with how the Linux login command works. In particular, you should be able to answer the following questions.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo4;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->1.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->How are users created in Linux?

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo4;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->2.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->What algorithms are used to hash passwords?

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo4;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->3.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Where is information derived from passwords stored?

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo4;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->4.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->How does the system verify a password submitted during login?

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo4;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->5.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Why is salt used, and how does it work?

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l2 level1 lfo4; margin: 0cm 0cm 5.35pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->6.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Who has access to the file that contains password-related information?

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 11.75pt -.25pt;">There are plenty of online resources for these questions. To help you get started, see “Getting Started on Linux Login/Passwords” in the Appendix.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 11.5pt -.25pt;">Our project will be extending the Linux login command using the provided password files for the application.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; text-indent: 0cm; line-height: 107%;">

<h2 style="margin-left: 19.25pt; text-indent: -20.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo14;" class="akch-demoted-h1"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="mso-bidi-font-size: 18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-bidi-font-weight: bold;">1.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]-->Project Details</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.5pt -.25pt;"><b>Getting Started: </b>To help you get started, we have provided two Python code files that demonstrate how user creation and login work under the hood.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l4 level1 lfo5;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->1.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><b><i>create_user.py</i></b>: creates a new user. Study its code to understand what it does and what conditions must be met to run it successfully. Pay close attention to what changes are made to the .<i>/app/shadow</i> file after creating a user. A thorough understanding of those changes will be useful throughout this project.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l4 level1 lfo5; margin: 0cm 0cm 5.5pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->2.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><b><i>check_login.py</i></b>: checks whether a user can log in with a given user ID and password pair. By analyzing the code, you will learn how a user is validated after submitting a password. In particular, look at how it retrieves the hash from the provided shadow file and compares it against the hash computed from the submitted password.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 23.5pt -.25pt;">Once you have a solid understanding of <i>create_user.py</i> and <i>check_login.py</i>, you are ready to proceed. Make sure to copy and paste the code from the two provided starter files into your 2FA.py. Do <b>not</b> import the files in your code.

<h2 style="margin-left: 19.25pt; text-indent: -20.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo14;" class="akch-demoted-h1"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="mso-bidi-font-size: 18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-bidi-font-weight: bold;">2.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]-->Task 1: Implementing 2FA (80% of grade)</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.45pt -.25pt;">In this task, you need to implement 2FA using the provided <b>token generator</b> (TG) executable, which serves as the second factor. The 2FA method uses tokens produced by TG to harden the login mechanism in Linux.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.75pt -.25pt;">In a typical 2FA deployment, a unique second-factor device is associated with each user (for example, your phone for Duo 2FA at Georgia Tech). In this project, the same TG will serve as the second factor for all accounts you create. To make this work, each user must be registered with TG along with a PIN.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: -.25pt;">Each user therefore has two accounts:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l6 level1 lfo6;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->One account on the 2FA system

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l6 level1 lfo6; margin: 0cm 0cm 5.7pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->One account on TG

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 13.75pt -.25pt;"><b>The Token Generator</b> and the <b>2FA Method</b> are described below. Implementation details are in the Implementation of 2FA section.

<h2 style="margin-left: -.25pt;">Token Generator (TG)</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 5.75pt;">Before moving to the 2FA method, it is important to understand how TG works. TG presents three options: ‘1’ to register a new user, ‘2’ to generate a token for an existing user, and ‘3’ to delete a user account.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; text-justify: inter-ideograph; text-indent: 0cm; line-height: 99%; margin: 0cm .3pt 6.0pt 0cm;"><b>NOTE: </b>You have been provided with the Token Generator executable. You only need to understand how it works so you can treat it as a black box. You do not need to implement TG.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.95pt -.25pt;"><b>If the user enters:</b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: -.25pt;"><b>‘1’</b> then:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l7 level1 lfo7;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->TG prompts the user for a user ID and a six-digit PIN.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l7 level1 lfo7;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->TG generates an <b>initial token IT</b> and creates an encrypted text file named after the user ID.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l7 level1 lfo7; margin: 0cm 0cm 5.45pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Deleting this file is equivalent to deleting the user’s TG account. The role of IT will become clear in the 2FA method description.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: -.25pt;"><b>‘2’</b> then:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l7 level1 lfo7;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->The user must provide their user ID and the correct PIN (similar to unlocking a phone with a PIN when the phone is the 2FA device).

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l7 level1 lfo7;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->If the correct information is provided, TG returns the <b>current token CT</b> and the <b>next token NT</b>.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l7 level1 lfo7; margin: 0cm 0cm 5.7pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->These tokens are used in the 2FA method.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 2.35pt -.25pt;"><b>‘3’</b> then:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l7 level1 lfo7; margin: 0cm 0cm 3.45pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->The user must provide the same information as in option ‘2’ (user ID and correct PIN).

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l7 level1 lfo7; margin: 0cm 0cm 5.45pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->TG returns the current token CT, deletes the user account, and removes the associated file.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 13.45pt; line-height: 104%;"><b>NOTE (Very Important): </b><i>After each TG operation, the user is prompted to confirm whether the corresponding task in the 2FA method completed successfully. If it did, the user must enter ‘y’ or ‘Y’. Any other input causes TG to revert to its previous state for that user.</i>

<h2 style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.65pt -.25pt;">The 2FA Method</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -13.25pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l3 level1 lfo8; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.95pt 13.25pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><b>1.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp; </span></b><!--[endif]--><b>Create a User Account </b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.45pt -.25pt;">When user U tries to create an account, the 2FA method requires four items: <b>username U</b>, <b>password P</b> (with confirmation), <b>salt</b>, and the <b>initial token IT</b> generated by TG when the user registered.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.75pt -.25pt;"><b>NOTE: </b>The PIN for TG and the password for the 2FA system must be different. However, the <b>username for the 2FA system</b> and the <b>user ID for TG</b> must be the same.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 11.5pt -.25pt;">The 2FA method takes token IT, concatenates it with password P to form the hardened password (P+IT), and passes this through the password hashing algorithm to produce the shadow file entry. With this entry saved, the new user is successfully created. The full process is illustrated in Figure 1 in the Appendix.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -13.25pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l3 level1 lfo8; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.95pt 13.25pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><b>2.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp; </span></b><!--[endif]--><b>Logging into a User Account </b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 12.4pt -.25pt;">After user U has been created, they can log into their account. For login, the user must provide <b>username U</b>, <b>password P</b>, <b>current token CT</b> from TG, and <b>next token NT</b> from TG<a title="" href="file:///C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/CQFProject/FALL2026/CS6238/Project2/Project2.pdf#_ftn2" name="_ftnref2"><sup><!-- [if !supportFootnotes]--><sup><span style="font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Arial',sans-serif; mso-fareast-font-family: Arial; color: black; mso-font-kerning: 0pt; mso-ligatures: none; mso-ansi-language: EN-GB; mso-fareast-language: EN-GB; mso-bidi-language: AR-SA;">[2]</span></sup><!--[endif]--></sup></a>.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; text-indent: 0cm; line-height: 107%;"><!-- [if mso & !supportInlineShapes & supportFields]><span
style='mso-element:field-begin;mso-field-lock:yes'></span><span

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 11.45pt -.25pt;">The 2FA method first checks whether user U exists. If so, it concatenates P and CT to construct the hardened password (P+CT), as done during user creation. This hardened password is validated against the hash in <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">./app/shadow</span>. After successful validation, P is concatenated with NT to form the new hardened password (P+NT). This value is hashed and used to update the corresponding field in <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">./app/shadow</span>. Based on whether the operation succeeded or failed, the user enters the confirmation response in TG, which determines whether the changes are saved or discarded. The full login process is illustrated in Figure 2 in the Appendix.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -13.25pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l3 level1 lfo8; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.95pt 13.25pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><b>3.<span style="font: 7.0pt 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp; </span></b><!--[endif]--><b>Update and Delete </b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.5pt -.25pt;">The 2FA system must support password updates to handle cases where a password is compromised or has expired. For an update, the user must provide <b>username U</b>, <b>password P</b>, <b>new password NP</b> (with confirmation), <b>new salt NS</b>, <b>current token CT</b>, and <b>next token NT</b> from TG.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.75pt -.25pt;">The 2FA system must also support account deletion. For delete, the user must provide <b>username U</b>, <b>password P</b>, and <b>current token CT</b>.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 13.35pt -.25pt;">The update and delete functionality should be modeled after the login functionality.

<h2 style="margin-left: -.25pt;">Implementation of 2FA</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.75pt -.25pt;"><b>IMPORTANT: </b>Follow the prompts <b><i>exactly</i></b> as specified below. Regrade requests based on incorrect prompt order will not be accepted.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.5pt -.25pt;">Once you are familiar with the 2FA method and TG, create a standalone program that implements the full 2FA method. Start from the Python code provided. Your code must implement the prompts below in the exact order listed.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.35pt -.25pt;">Your program must handle the following steps:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -54.0pt; margin: 0cm 0cm 2.4pt 72.05pt;">1. <b>Prompting user for action selection</b>: Prompt the user with the following menu: <span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Select an action:</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -16.25pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l8 level1 lfo9; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 87.55pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">1)<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Create a user</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -16.25pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l8 level1 lfo9; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 87.55pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">2)<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Login</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -16.25pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l8 level1 lfo9; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 87.55pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">3)<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Update password</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -16.25pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l8 level1 lfo9; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 4.85pt 87.55pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">4)<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]--><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Delete user account</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.45pt -.25pt;">Your program must also prompt for all required inputs (username, password, salt, and tokens) for each action.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 1.7pt -.25pt;">Prompt for action 1 (create user):

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Username: Alice</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Password: Alice123</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Confirm Password: Alice123</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Salt: salt0123</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 72.05pt; line-height: 145%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 145%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Initial Token: eYKCaN0kLB7T0.3Q.vPs40</span> Prompt for action 2 (login):

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Username: Alice</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Password: Alice123</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Current Token: eYKCaN0kLB7T0.3Q.vPs40</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 72.05pt; line-height: 143%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 3.55pt -.75pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 143%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Next Token: iGxl329/ugOeSnhOzYE1B/</span> Prompt for action 3 (update password):

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 262.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Username: Alice</span> <span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Password: Alice123</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">New Password: New-Password</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 192.2pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Confirm New Password: New-Password</span> <span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">New Salt: salt3210</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Current Token: eYKCaN0kLB7T0.3Q.vPs40</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 72.05pt; line-height: 143%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 143%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Next Token: iGxl329/ugOeSnhOzYE1B/</span> Prompt for action 4 (delete user):

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 262.75pt 0cm 71.8pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Username: Alice</span> <span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Password: Alice123</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.5pt -.25pt;">When a user successfully completes an action, the 2FA.py program should re-prompt for action selection from the user.

This counts as a failed creation attempt. All inputs from step (a) must be collected before checking whether the user exists.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 54.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->c.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->If the user does not exist, create the account. Update both <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">./app/shadow</span> and

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 2.85pt 54.55pt;"><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">./app/passwd</span>.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 2.4pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->d.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Add a corresponding home directory entry to <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">./app/passwd</span> (this directory does not need to be created).

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.95pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->e.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->On success, print <b>“SUCCESS: &lt;user-id&gt; created”</b>.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.75pt -.25pt;"><b>NOTE: </b>The salt remains the same for a user account unless the user updates or recreates their account.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level1 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 3.45pt 35.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->3.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><b>Login</b> (20 pts.): If ‘2’ is selected, the program must:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 1.7pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->a.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Collect the following inputs from the user:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 90.55pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Username: Alice</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 90.55pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Password: Alice123</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 0cm 90.55pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Current Token: eYKCaN0kLB7T0.3Q.vPs40</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 169.75pt 3.1pt 90.55pt;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">Next Token: iGxl329/ugOeSnhOzYE1B/</span>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 2.35pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->b.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Execute the complete login process described in the 2FA Method section.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 2.1pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->c.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><b>“SUCCESS: Login Successful”</b> on success.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 2.5pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->d.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->If the user does not exist, display <b>“FAILURE: user &lt;username&gt; does not exist”</b>. <p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 54.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->e.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->If the password or token is incorrect, display <b>“FAILURE: either passwd or token incorrect”</b>.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level1 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 3.45pt 35.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->4.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><b>Password Update</b> (15 pts.): If ‘3’ is selected, the program must:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 54.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->a.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Prompt for username, password, new password, confirm new password, new salt, current token, and next token, in that order. <p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 1.85pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->b.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->On success, display <b>“SUCCESS: user &lt;username&gt; updated”</b>.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 54.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->c.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Handle errors the same way as the login functionality.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level1 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 3.45pt 35.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->5.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]--><b>Deleting a User</b> (15 pts.): If ‘4’ is selected, the program must:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 2.35pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->a.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Prompt for username, password, and current token, in that order.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 2.35pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->b.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->If all values are correct, remove all entries for the user.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 1.85pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->c.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->On success, display <b>“SUCCESS: user &lt;username&gt; Deleted”</b>.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l13 level2 lfo10; margin: 0cm 0cm 11.35pt 54.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->d.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Error handling must follow the same pattern as the login functionality.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.95pt -.25pt;"><b>Keep the following in mind as you work on the project:</b>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l5 level1 lfo11; margin: 0cm 0cm 3.45pt 35.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->1.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->After every successful request, enter ‘y’ or ‘Y’ when TG prompts for confirmation. Do not enter ‘y’ or ‘Y’ before your script has completed the task.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 35.3pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l5 level1 lfo11;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->2.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->The interaction between your 2FA implementation and TG is manual. Tokens must be copied and pasted from TG into your 2FA program.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l5 level1 lfo11; margin: 0cm 0cm 3.45pt 35.3pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->3.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Use the correct TG option for each 2FA function: enter ‘1’ when creating a user, ‘2’ when logging in or updating a password, and ‘3’ when deleting a user.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; text-indent: 0cm; line-height: 107%;">

<h2 style="margin-left: 19.25pt; text-indent: -20.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo14;" class="akch-demoted-h1"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="mso-bidi-font-size: 18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-bidi-font-weight: bold;">3.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]-->Task 2: Security Analysis of 2FA (20% of grade)</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 6.55pt -.25pt;">Complete a security analysis of the implemented 2FA method. Your analysis must address the following:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l10 level1 lfo12;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Discuss two advantages, two disadvantages, and two possible attacks on the 2FA method described in this project.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l10 level1 lfo12;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Consider a realistic production deployment of this 2FA scheme. Recommend one concrete improvement.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l10 level1 lfo12; margin: 0cm 0cm 23.2pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Describe how you would implement this 2FA scheme in a client-server setting, and explain how you would secure the token transfer between the two systems.

<h2 style="margin-left: 19.25pt; text-indent: -20.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo14;" class="akch-demoted-h1"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="mso-bidi-font-size: 18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-bidi-font-weight: bold;">4.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]-->Project Deliverables</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: -.25pt;">Submit the following to the Gradescope assignment:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l9 level1 lfo13; margin: 0cm 0cm 4.85pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Your Python script for the 2FA implementation. The file must be named <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">2FA.py</span>.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 36.05pt; text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l9 level1 lfo13;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->A PDF report named <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">&lt;gtid&gt;_2FA.pdf</span>. For example, for a student with GT username “gpburdell”, the file would be named <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">gpburdell_2FA.pdf</span>. The report must contain:

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: -18.0pt; mso-list: l9 level1 lfo13; margin: 0cm 0cm 3.45pt 36.05pt;"><!-- [if !supportLists]-->•<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; </span><!--[endif]-->Your answers for Task 2, under a section titled “Task 2”

<h2 style="text-indent: -20.0pt; mso-list: l0 level1 lfo14; margin: 0cm 0cm 0cm 19.25pt;" class="akch-demoted-h1"><!-- [if !supportLists]--><span style="mso-bidi-font-size: 18.0pt; line-height: 107%; mso-bidi-font-weight: bold;">5.<span style="font-style: normal; font-variant: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-size: 7pt; line-height: normal; font-family: 'Times New Roman';">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><!--[endif]-->Appendix – Figures</h2>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: center; line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 9.1pt .9pt;" align="center"><i>Figure 2: Logging into an Account</i>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm; text-indent: 0cm; line-height: 107%;">

<h2 style="margin-left: -.25pt;">Getting Started on Linux Login/Passwords</h2>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 1.8pt -.25pt;">When Linux creates a user, it prompts for a password. Depending on the Linux version, one of several algorithms is selected for password hashing. The system generates a random salt, uses it to produce a one-way hash, and stores that hash with the user’s details in <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">/etc/shadow</span>. A sample entry looks like this:

<div style="mso-element: para-border-div; border: solid #CCCCCC 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: solid #CCCCCC .25pt; padding: 0cm 0cm 0cm 0cm; margin-left: 17.3pt; margin-right: 0cm;">
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 6.65pt; line-height: 94%; border: none; mso-border-alt: solid #CCCCCC .25pt; padding: 0cm; mso-padding-alt: 0cm 0cm 0cm 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 8.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 94%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">cs6238:$6$UPICuFgR$0bA5equUygMEptwf//rCS6gVVToghXSkLb0NqVYPyBmkNMunvPcIj7G03uy5iszpNfbT7WqpDG cDRAQN6hpEil:17732:0:99999:7:::</span>

</div>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 4.8pt -.25pt;">This entry has 9 fields separated by “:”. The first field is the username; the second is the hash. The hash itself contains three sub-fields separated by “$”. The first sub-field identifies the hashing algorithm (“6” denotes SHA-512). The second is the salt, which makes each hash unique. The third is the hash of the combined salt and password. You can verify hash generation using the following Perl one-liner in your Ubuntu terminal:

<div style="mso-element: para-border-div; border: solid #CCCCCC 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: solid #CCCCCC .25pt; padding: 0cm 0cm 0cm 0cm; margin-left: 17.3pt; margin-right: 0cm;">
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 4.4pt; line-height: 94%; border: none; mso-border-alt: solid #CCCCCC .25pt; padding: 0cm; mso-padding-alt: 0cm 0cm 0cm 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 8.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 94%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">perl -e ‘print crypt(“&lt;PASSWORD&gt;”,”\$&lt;HASH-ALGO&gt;\$&lt;SALT-VALUE&gt;\$”) . “\n”‘</span>

</div>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height: 107%; margin: 0cm 0cm 5.6pt -.25pt;">Here: <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">&lt;PASSWORD&gt;</span> = cs6238,&nbsp; <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">&lt;HASH-ALGO&gt;</span> = 6,&nbsp; <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">&lt;SALT-VALUE&gt;</span> = UPICuFgR

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.8pt -.25pt;"><b>Note: </b>Explore all other fields in the shadow file, as you will need to know them for this project.

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin: 0cm 0cm 5.0pt -.25pt;">After storing the hash in <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">/etc/shadow</span>, the system creates a home directory and adds an entry for the user in <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">/etc/passwd</span>, which stores essential account information used during login. This file contains one entry per line per user. An entry in <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">/etc/passwd</span> for user cs6238 looks like this:

<div style="mso-element: para-border-div; border: solid #CCCCCC 1.0pt; mso-border-alt: solid #CCCCCC .25pt; padding: 0cm 0cm 0cm 0cm; margin-left: 18.05pt; margin-right: 0cm;">
<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-indent: 0cm; line-height: 107%; border: none; mso-border-alt: solid #CCCCCC .25pt; padding: 0cm; mso-padding-alt: 0cm 0cm 0cm 0cm; margin: 0cm 0cm 5.5pt 0cm;"><span style="font-size: 9.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 107%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">cs6238:x:1000:1000:CS6238,,,:/home/cs6238:/bin/bash</span>

</div>
<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom: 3.45pt;">Each entry in <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">/etc/passwd</span> has seven fields separated by “:”. The first field is the username. The second is the password field, where “x” indicates that the actual hash is in the shadow file. The next two fields are the UID and GID. The last two are the user’s home directory and the path to their login shell. A detailed review of <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">/etc/passwd</span> is not required for this project, but exploring it further is encouraged. Once the <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; mso-bidi-font-size: 12.0pt; line-height: 103%; font-family: 'Courier New'; mso-fareast-font-family: 'Courier New';">/etc/passwd</span> entry is written, user creation is complete.
